name: Demolition Grenade
body:
Aura weak transmutation; CL 1; Slot none; Price 50 gp; Weight 1 lb.

DESCRIPTION

This heavy glass bulb is filled with a milky red liquid.

The bulb may be thrown as a ranged touch attack. If it strikes an object it shatters and the liquid immediately covers the object. That object becomes easier to destroy or break. The hardness and Break DC of the object reduce by 2. The bulb has enough liquid to cover 1 medium sized object or a 5’ x 5’ area on a larger object, such as a wall or floor.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells break; Cost 25 gp
